title: Grateful Dead Live at Roscoe Maples Pavilion, Stanford on 1973-02-09
source: Recording Info: MR > R (Bob Menke) > R (Pat Lee); Transfer Info: Technics 1506 w/Lamb Labs Dolby decoder > WAV (24bit/96k) > Apogee Mini Me 24/96 > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering > FLAC; Mastered By Matt Smith

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a 1973 show that shines with a scorching Dark Star→Eyes→China Doll sequence, vibrant Here Comes Sunshine and Sugar Magnolia, all presented in clear, trippy mix.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the musical flow – the debut of Eyes‑, the intense Dark Star>Eyes>China Doll trifecta, and classic second‑set highlights like Here Comes Sunshine and Uncle John’s Band. The recording is a soundboard (sbd) source that sounds clean enough to enjoy the subtle studio‑like delays praised by one fan, with no major audio flaws reported.

ai_rating.rationale: Enthusiastic show commentary and numerous standout moments outweigh the lack of detailed recording notes; soundboard source is assumed solid, yielding a high overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note a clear mix with interesting delay effects (“trippy with Donna on delay behind Phil”), but no complaints of muddy or dropout issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows strongly, debuting new material like Eyes‑ and China Doll early, then moving through a powerful second half with classic jams and tight transitions.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Starts the night with Row Jimmy; praised for vocal delivery on Loose Lucy and overall guitar work.
band_member_comments.Phil: Mentioned in relation to a delay effect (“Donna on delay behind Phil”), suggesting his bass sits nicely under the mix.
